exceptions.reason: Graph canvas: nodes sit on a pannable, zoomable plane, so their on-screen size, position and clipping depend on the zoom level the user picks. Node typography, icons, ARIA and label consistency are still checked. Edge-label contrast cannot be measured on SVG text.
React Flow's edge layer is an unbounded SVG plane positioned by the viewport transform.
Visually hidden text (screen-reader labels, the skip link until focused, nav labels in the compact icon-only navigation) is clipped on purpose.

Vertical navigation list (desktop): rows are a single list separated by their own hover/active fill, like any OS sidebar. The compact (<=760px) icon row uses an 8px gap and is not affected by this rule's intent.
Segmented control: tabs share one track by design; separation comes from the selected thumb.
Result list rows separated by a 1px divider; an 8px gap between list rows would break the list rhythm. Row insets from the list container are still checked.

Icon-only buttons are square hit targets (24-32px) with a centered 14-16px glyph; the 8px text inset rule targets labelled buttons. Their size is still checked by control-size (>=24px) and they carry text tooltips.
Every Switch is rendered by components/ui/switch.jsx with a visible <label for> next to it; the label, not a tooltip, names it.
Checkboxes are named by a wrapping or associated visible <label> (or aria-label in table rows); a tooltip would duplicate it.
Notification badge on the compact icon-only nav deliberately overlaps the button corner (standard badge pattern).
Link-variant buttons render as inline text links with no box; the 8px inset applies to boxed buttons. Their hit height is held at >=24px.
Desktop chrome: menu-bar titles and status-bar segments are contiguous strips (Windows/VS Code convention); each segment has its own hover fill and the status bar separates segments with 1px rules.
Desktop view toolbar: 26px toolbar buttons are vertically centred in the 36px toolbar row (5px each side), like Fluent/VS Code command bars. Horizontal spacing still uses the 8px grid.
